data.name: Zadun Los Cabos, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve
data.address: Blvd. Mar de Cortez, 23403 San José del Cabo, B.C.S., Mexico
data.description:
On a beach along the Pacific Ocean, this upscale resort is 1 km from the Puerto Los Cabos golf course and 55 km from Cabo Pulmo National Marine Park. It's 20 km from Los Cabos International Airport.
Accommodations range from fashionable rooms to 2-bedroom villas with separate living rooms, plunge pools, kitchens and 8-person dining tables. All have living areas, terraces and ocean views, as well as Wi-Fi, flat-screens and iPod docks. There's butler service.
Amenities include 3 chic restaurants, a bar
and a spa, plus an outdoor pool, and a 24-hour gym with fitness classes. Valet parking and breakfast are available.
